Vestments of Revelation (0/8) Circlet of Revelation Shoulderpads of Revelation Belt of Revelation Leggings of Revelation Sandals of Revelation Bindings of Revelation Gloves of Revelation Robe of Revelation (2) Set : Reduces the cooldown of Power Word: Barrier by 30 sec and Surge of Light now also makes Prayer of Healing and Greater Heal instant cast.
